title: Offline terminal-reward noise audit at fixed checkpoints (stage 3)
hypothesis: Given the state and both actions, the noise of a single terminal win/loss prize may mask action-value differences and make it hard for the policy to learn state-dependent structure.
status_of_hypothesis: to be tested; it is not assumed to be the cause of the T=3 failures

sources.manifest: E/manifests/asamp_abc_q60_baseline.json (game/PPO/verifier config is read from resolved)

A400.contents: actor.* and critic.* float32 arrays only (no opponent, no optimizer)
A400.opponent_rule: reconstructed as an exact copy of the A400 actor. Evidence required from the original runner: train_step refreshes the snapshot when global_update % snapshot_every(20) == 0 BEFORE exporting weights when global_update % weights_every(25) == 0, so at g=400 the refresh precedes the export; events.jsonl must show snapshot_refresh(periodic, g=400) before checkpoint_saved(periodic_weights, update_00400) and snapshot_refresh(phase_B_entry, g=400) after it. If this evidence is missing the audit records the limitation instead of claiming an exact reconstruction.
A400.replay_check: dev-tier verifier on the loaded actor must reproduce the recorded A400 development call's stage-3 continuation gain

C_min.contents: actor, critic, opponent state_dicts (+ optimizer states, not used)
C_min.opponent_rule: the opponent state_dict saved in the checkpoint; whether it equals the actor is reported
C_min.replay_check: dev-tier verifier on the loaded actor must reproduce the recorded minimum C call's dReach

frozen_weights: no optimizer is stepped, the snapshot is never refreshed during the audit, gradients are read from autograd only; after the audit the in-memory actor/critic/opponent are compared with a fresh load of the same checkpoint file
state_distribution: phase-A exploring starts restored exactly: E run_experiment.sample_starts(spec, StartSampler(spec, 10), {'3': 512}, rng) = StartSampler.balanced on D3=[-440,440] (88 width-10 bins, bin then uniform), no center mixture, learner role uniform {0,1}; learner-signed gap d = d0 (role 0) or -d0 (role 1)
rollout: one stage-3 transition per state with the training collector code path (terminal_noise.collect_batch_k with K=8, trace=True): learner action ~ actor Beta(obs(3,d)), opponent action ~ opponent Beta(obs(3,-d)) (sampled, never the mean action), stored actions float32 clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6], log-probs from torch Beta on the stored action; noise copy 1 = (eps0, eps1) drawn exactly as the collector draws its environment noise; copies 2..8 from a separate stream, array shape (7, 2, n) = (copy, player, episode)

audit_rng.seed_sequence: SeedSequence([tag, seed, q, stream_id]); independent of every training stream (training uses SeedSequence([seed, q, ns]))
audit_rng.note: the same audit streams are used for A400 and C_min of a seed (common random numbers for states and noise; actions differ because the policies differ)

scale.fixed: no additional batches or seeds are added after results are seen

estimators.K1: r = -k e_L^2 + R(y + xi_1)  (the original single realized prize)
estimators.K8: r = -k e_L^2 + mean_{j=1..8} R(y + xi_j), xi_1 shared with K1; cost charged once
estimators.ref: r = -k e_L^2 + w_l + dW * F_xi(y); offline reference only, never a training reward

definitions.y: d + e_L - e_O (learner-signed pre-noise gap after actions)
definitions.p: F_xi(y) = win probability given (d, e_L, e_O)
definitions.R: realized prize w_h / w_l / (w_h+w_l)/2 from the final gap
definitions.V: critic(obs(3, d)) of the checkpoint (float32 -> float64)
definitions.raw_advantage: A_E = r_E - V (gamma = lambda = 1, one terminal transition, zero bootstrap)
definitions.score: s_i = grad_theta log pi_theta(a_i | s_i) over all actor parameters, per sample via torch.func (reward and V detached)
definitions.raw_gradient: g_raw = (1/n) sum_{i in region} A_E,i s_i  (unnormalized, unclipped; n = 512 so g_all = g_center + g_outer)
definitions.surrogate_gradient: g_sur = (1/n) sum_{i in region} Ahat_E,i s_i with Ahat = (A - mean A)/(population SD A + 1e-8) over the whole 512-sample batch in float32, exactly the PPO normalization; equals -grad(actor_loss) of CurriculumPPO's clipped surrogate at ratio 1 before any optimizer step (checked by autograd); reported as an ascent direction
definitions.regions: all; center |d| <= B (B = 220 at q60, relative tolerance 1e-9 as in E metrics.stage_region_metrics); outer |d| > B

cross_batch_statistics (per grad type, e.total_variance: V = (1/63) sum_b |g_b - gbar|^2 (trace of the sample covariance)
cross_batch_statistics (per grad type, e.deviation_from_reference: D = mean_b |g_b - g_ref,b|^2 (same batch, same states/actions); also |gbar - gbar_ref| and cos(gbar, gbar_ref)
cross_batch_statistics (per grad type, e.expected_direction_alignment: c_loo = mean_b cos(g_b, gbar_ref^(-b)), gbar_ref^(-b) = mean of the reference estimator's gradients (same type and region) over the other 63 batches
cross_batch_statistics (per grad type, e.clip_fraction: surrogate, all region only: fraction of batches with |g_sur| > max_grad_norm 0.5 (full-batch norm; PPO clips per 256-minibatch, so this is descriptive)

derived_raw.phi: D_K1 / V_K1 = share of the per-batch raw-gradient variance caused by terminal noise under K=1
derived_raw.rho: V_K8 / V_K1 = raw-gradient estimator variance ratio
derived_raw.signal_sq: S2 = |gbar_ref|^2 - V_ref/64 (debiased squared norm of the expected raw gradient)
derived_raw.tau: D_K1 / S2 = per-batch terminal gradient-noise energy relative to the signal energy (undefined if S2 <= 0)
derived_raw.D_pred: mean_b (1/n^2) sum_{i in region} dW^2 p_i (1-p_i) |s_i|^2 / K (exact conditional expectation of D given states and actions)

definitions.reward_and_advantage: pooled over the 64 x 512 samples of each region: mean and variance of r_E and A_E for E in {K1, K8, ref}; mean conditional terminal variance dW^2 p(1-p); per width-20 d-bin profiles for figures

math_and_implementation_checks.outer_prizes_identical: for |d| > B: prize_K1 == prize_K8 == prize_ref exactly and p in {0, 1} exactly
math_and_implementation_checks.cost_charged_once: r_E - prize_E is bitwise identical across E and equals -k e_L^2
math_and_implementation_checks.first_copy_shared: prize_K1 == copy 1 and prize_K8 == mean of the 8 copies including copy 1; collector returns/advantages equal r_K8 and r_K8 - V
math_and_implementation_checks.conditional_mean_center: mean(prize_K - prize_ref) over center samples: |z| <= 4 for K in {1, 8}
math_and_implementation_checks.conditional_variance_center: mean((prize_K - prize_ref)^2) vs mean(dW^2 p(1-p))/K over center samples: |z| <= 4 for K in {1, 8} (z from the per-sample SE)
math_and_implementation_checks.gradient_noise_matches_theory: center raw gradient: mean_b D_K,b vs mean_b D_pred,K,b: |z| <= 4 for K in {1, 8} (z from the per-batch SE)
math_and_implementation_checks.surrogate_equals_ppo_autograd: first batch of every checkpoint: (1/n) S^T Ahat equals -grad of the PPO clipped-surrogate actor loss over the full batch, and (1/n) S^T A equals grad of mean(A log pi); max abs diff <= 1e-4 * max abs component
math_and_implementation_checks.weights_unchanged: after the audit the actor, critic and opponent tensors equal a fresh load of the checkpoint file
math_and_implementation_checks.checkpoint_replay: dev verifier replay matches the recorded call (abs diff <= 1e-12)
math_and_implementation_checks.opponent_provenance: A400 event-order evidence present (see checkpoints.A400.opponent_rule); C_min opponent read from the file

questions_and_reading_rules.Q1_terminal_noise_large_vs_signal: yes at a checkpoint if, in the center region, phi >= 0.25 and tau > 1 in all 3 seeds; otherwise reported with the values
questions_and_reading_rules.Q2_K8_improves_center_gradient_not_only_: judged on the gradient metrics (rho for raw, c_loo and SNR for the normalized surrogate); reward/advantage variance reductions alone never count
questions_and_reading_rules.Q3_direction_consistent_across_seeds: each metric's direction (K8 better or not) reported per seed; consistent = same direction in 3/3
questions_and_reading_rules.Q4_A400_vs_Cmin: all metrics reported side by side for both checkpoints; descriptive only

step2_entry_rule.enter_step2_iff: every math/implementation check passes AND, at A400, center region, in each of the 3 seeds: (G1) phi_raw >= 0.25, (G2) rho_raw <= 0.80, (G3) c_loo(surrogate, K8) > c_loo(surrogate, K1)
step2_entry_rule.reason_for_A400: Step 2 is an A-only training comparison; A400 is the late-A state of the same training protocol. C_min is reported for context and does not enter the rule.
step2_entry_rule.not_criteria: reward variance, advantage variance, training reward, the outer/all regions, SNR values
step2_entry_rule.if_not_met: report the results, state which item failed, and stop; no further audit batches, seeds or alternative metrics

out_of_scope: B/C, q50 and formal; no change to verifier, certification thresholds, concentration, network, learning rate or PPO parameters
